title: Kailasa Temple, Ellora
geometryBasis: The native 22-vertex monument envelope records the location of the carved court. The documented 82 by 46 m measurement controls the extracted interior and the mapped extent controls the exterior cliff transition.
sectionBasis: Known 32 m rear scarp, 8 m plinth, connected axial sanctuary and 31 m tower. Qualla originals document coarse ash-gray and ochre basalt, bands of carving, elephant supports and full depth of exposed faces.
limitations: Positions of individual reliefs, vestibules, minor shrines and worn carving require interpretation. The measured court and overall vertical forms control the silhouette.

Original elevations over the known court are too coarse and slope through the structure. The model will supply the surveyed excavation as a bounded placement opening and include its floor and matching basalt rim. The original elevation samples and separate original-field preview are preserved.
Outside the Cave 16 court, neighboring caves, extensive interiors and fine inscriptions are outside scope. Individual carved figures are conveyed by general stone relief geometry.

groundCutout.basis: Documented 82 by 46 metre Kailasa court anchored to the native location. The carved floor and basalt scarp cover the entire opening. Source elevation remains independent.
